translations.idiomatic: Music Nine

translations.literal: Opening corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: Opening section mark

translations.literal: (Music Chapter Three) closing corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: (Music Chapter Three) closing section mark

sentences.zh: ○太廟常享禘袷加上徽號郊前朝享皇后別廟建隆以來祀享太廟一十六首迎神，《禮安》

translations.literal: ○ Regular Imperial Ancestral Temple offerings, ti and xia rites, adding honorific titles, pre-suburban court offerings, the empress's separate temple—sixteen hymns for Imperial Ancestral Temple sacrifices since Jianlong: inviting the spirits, to the tune 《Lian》
translations.idiomatic: ○ Regular Imperial Ancestral Temple offerings, ti and xia rites, bestowal of honorific titles, pre-suburban court sacrifices, the empress's separate shrine—sixteen hymns for sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple since the Jianlong reign: inviting the spirits down, to the tune 《Lian》

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn is the pure temple; we come to perform the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and still stands the pure temple; we come to offer the sacrifice.

translations.literal: The spirits that have drawn near in thought are honored in a rite as if they were present.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits we summon in thought are feasted as though they stood present at the offering.

translations.literal: We scrupulously maintain imposing ritual bearing and strictly array the ceremonial guard.
translations.idiomatic: Every gesture of ritual is scrupulously kept; the ceremonial escort is drawn up in full array.

translations.literal: Blessings descend in abundance, that the age may endure forever.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings pour down without stint, that the line may flourish through endless ages.

sentences.zh: 皇帝行，《隆安》工祝升階，賓屍在位。

translations.literal: The emperor's procession, to the tune 《Long'an》: the chief invocator ascends the steps; the surrogate spirit-host takes his place.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's procession, to the tune 《Long'an》: the master invocator mounts the steps; the spirit-proxy stands in his station.

translations.literal: We reverently fulfill filial remembrance and truly perform the meticulous sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In reverent filial devotion we reach our ancestors and duly complete the painstaking rite.

translations.literal: The assisting ministers have their proper forms; we can reverently perform this service.
translations.idiomatic: The assisting ministers move in ordered ritual; each office is reverently discharged.

translations.literal: Solemn and respectful is their bearing; through it the refined intent is conveyed.
translations.idiomatic: Grave and reverent is their demeanor, carrying this pure devotion through to the end.

sentences.zh: 奠瓚用《瑞木》木符啟瑞，著象成文。

translations.literal: Offering the libation vessel, to the tune 《Ruimu》: the wooden tally opens the auspice and takes form as a patterned emblem.
translations.idiomatic: Offering the libation vessel, to the tune 《Ruimu》: the wooden tally heralds the omen and takes shape as a patterned emblem.

translations.literal: How manifest is the great title; it harmonizes with the enlightened ruler.
translations.idiomatic: How radiant is the great honorific title, in accord with the enlightened sovereign.

translations.literal: The numinous mandate has its allotment; great felicity opens and divides.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred mandate has its destined bearer; great felicity unfolds without limit.

translations.literal: We sing to raise the offering; blessings and excellence spread on every side.
translations.idiomatic: We sing as the offering is raised; blessing and excellence resound far and wide.

sentences.zh: 又《馴象》嘉彼馴象，來歸帝鄉。

translations.literal: Again, 《Tamed Elephant》: how fine is that tamed elephant, come home to the imperial domain.
translations.idiomatic: Again, to the tune 《Xunxiang》: how fine is that tamed elephant, come home to the imperial capital.

translations.literal: The southern regions nurture its substance; the central realm manifests the omen.
translations.idiomatic: The southern lands nurtured its being; the central realm received the auspicious sign.

translations.literal: Benevolence reaches the great beast; virtue softens distant wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolence moves even the mighty beast; virtue quiets the farthest wilds.

translations.literal: Where feeling stirs, response comes; divine transformation knows no bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Where feeling stirs, response follows; the spirit's transforming power knows no bounds.

translations.literal: Again, 《Jade Crow》
translations.idiomatic: Again, to the tune 《Yuwu》

translations.literal: The plain white crow alights; pure essence is truly stored.
translations.idiomatic: The plain white crow comes to rest; pure essence is truly preserved.

translations.literal: Its name matches the auspicious record; its color responds to the metal quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Its name accords with the book of omens; its hue answers to the western quarter of metal.

translations.literal: Pure and white, it moves at ease; its crested plumes rise and flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Pure white and unhurried in bearing, its crested feathers lift and flare.

translations.literal: Filial thought stirs response; imperial virtue spreads ever wider.
translations.idiomatic: Filial devotion stirs response; imperial virtue spreads ever further.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《豐安》維犧維牲，以炰以烹。

translations.literal: Presenting the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》: whether victim or sacrificial beast, it is roasted and cooked.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》: victims and sacrificial beasts, roasted and boiled for the rite.

translations.literal: The hand-drums are set in place; the offering broth is made pure.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-drums are set in place; the sacrificial broth is made pure.

translations.literal: How abundant is this stand; how solemn and still its resonance.
translations.idiomatic: How rich is this offering stand; how solemn and deep its resonance.

translations.literal: Solemn and harmonious are the assisting ministers; fortune and emolument come to fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and harmonious are the assisting ministers; fortune and blessing reach completion.

sentences.zh: 酌獻僖祖室，《大善》湯湯洪河，經啟長源。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Xi, to the tune 《Dashan》: vast and rolling is the mighty river, opening the long source.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Xi, to the tune 《Dashan》: vast and rolling is the mighty river, opening the long source.

translations.literal: Luxuriant is the fine tree, springing from the root.
translations.idiomatic: Luxuriant is the noble tree, rising from its root.

translations.literal: Great is the lofty foundation, issuing from the gate of blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Great is the lofty foundation, issuing from the gate of blessing.

translations.literal: Auspice is sent forth and abundance handed down; for endless ages descendants are bequeathed.
translations.idiomatic: Auspice is sent forth and abundance handed down; through endless ages descendants are bequeathed.

sentences.zh: 順祖室，《大寧》元鍾九千，生於仲呂。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Shun, to the tune 《Daning》: the primal bell of nine thousand [pounds], born in the zhonglü pitch.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Shun, to the tune 《Daning》: the primal bell of nine thousand [pounds], born in the zhonglü pitch.

translations.literal: A lofty terrace of nine tiers rises from accumulated earth.
translations.idiomatic: A lofty terrace of nine tiers rises from accumulated earth.

translations.literal: As the brilliant sun ascends, the hexagram Mingyi takes the lead.
translations.idiomatic: As the brilliant sun ascends, the hexagram Mingyi takes the lead.

translations.literal: The filial grandson becomes emperor, following in the martial way of his ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: The filial grandson becomes emperor, following in the martial way of his ancestors.

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Yi, to the tune 《Dashun》
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Yi, to the tune 《Dashun》

translations.literal: Bright, bright is our ancestor; accumulated virtue is wholly fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, bright is our ancestor; accumulated virtue is wholly fitting.

translations.literal: He first continued the spreading gourd-vine; he was about to exalt the root and branches.
translations.idiomatic: He first continued the spreading line; he was about to exalt root and branch alike.

translations.literal: Thus he drew on the thread of blessing and made manifest the imperial foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he drew on the thread of blessing and made manifest the imperial foundation.

translations.literal: Solemn and still is the pure temple; forever joined in doubled radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and still is the pure temple; forever joined in doubled radiance.

sentences.zh: 宣祖室，《大慶》艱難積行，綿長鍾慶。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Xuan, to the tune 《Daqing》: through hardship virtue was accumulated; long and enduring, blessing was struck.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Xuan, to the tune 《Daqing》: through hardship virtue was accumulated; long and enduring, blessing was struck.

translations.literal: In the time of Tongren, gaining the lord, all was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of fellowship, once the lord was gained, all was settled.

translations.literal: Once the ancestral line was ordered, then dance and song were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Once the ancestral line was ordered, dance and hymn were restored.

translations.literal: Through classic martial achievement he opened the beginning; forever he makes manifest the great mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Through classic martial achievement he opened the beginning; forever he makes manifest the great mandate.

sentences.zh: 太祖室，《大定》猗歟太祖，受命於天！

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Taizu, to the tune 《Dading》: how great is Emperor Taizu, receiving the mandate from Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Taizu, to the tune 《Dading》: how great is Emperor Taizu, receiving the mandate from Heaven!

translations.literal: His transforming influence spread through the realm; his achievements overflow the bamboo annals.
translations.idiomatic: His transforming influence spread through the realm; his achievements overflow the historical records.

translations.literal: His martial power shook and shone; his cultured virtue was proclaimed and spread.
translations.idiomatic: His martial power shook and shone; his cultured virtue was proclaimed and spread.

translations.literal: He opened the foundation and handed down the succession for a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the foundation and handed down the succession for endless ages.

sentences.zh: 太宗室，《大盛》赫赫皇運，明明太宗。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Taizong, to the tune 《Dasheng》: brilliant is the imperial fortune; bright, bright is Emperor Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Taizong, to the tune 《Dasheng》: brilliant is the imperial fortune; bright, bright is Emperor Taizong.

translations.literal: The four distant quarters all arrived; at one transformation, the age was harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: The four distant quarters all arrived; at one transformation, the age was harmonious.

translations.literal: His sagely writings blazed and shone; his sagehood was complete, warm and reverent.
translations.idiomatic: His sagely writings blazed and shone; his sagehood was complete, warm and reverent.

translations.literal: For a thousand ages and ten thousand sacrifices, forever resound pipes and bells.
translations.idiomatic: For a thousand ages and ten thousand sacrifices, forever resound pipes and bells.

translations.literal: Receiving the blessing, to the tune 《Xi'an》
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the blessing, to the tune 《Xi'an》

translations.literal: Fine millet and excellent ale, abundant fat victims and whole beasts.
translations.idiomatic: Fine millet and excellent ale, abundant fat victims and whole beasts.

translations.literal: The spirits' scrutiny is greatly manifest; they enjoy this auspicious purification.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits' scrutiny is greatly manifest; they accept this auspicious purification.

translations.literal: From dawn to dusk we perform the meticulous sacrifice; in filial piety we serve the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: From dawn to dusk we perform the meticulous sacrifice; in filial piety we serve the ancestors.

translations.literal: Forever grant pure blessing; merit reaches to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Forever grant pure blessing; merit reaches to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《正安》已象文治，乃觀武成。

translations.literal: Second offering, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: the pattern of civil governance is already set; now we behold martial achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: the pattern of civil governance is already set; now we behold martial achievement.

translations.literal: Advance and retreat have their measure; imposing ritual bearing is fully made clear.
translations.idiomatic: Advance and retreat have their measure; imposing ritual bearing is fully made clear.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《正安》《常武》徂征，詩人所稱。

translations.literal: Final offering, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: the expedition of 《Chángwǔ》, as the poets praised.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: the expedition of 《Changwu》, as the poets praised.

translations.literal: The battle-axe stands like a mountain; its image is almost to be doubted.
translations.idiomatic: The battle-axe stands like a mountain; its image is almost beyond belief.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《豐安》肥腯之牲，既析既薦，鬱鬯之酒，已酌已獻。

translations.literal: Withdrawing the offering vessels, to the tune 《Feng'an》: fat victims have been cut apart and presented; the aromatic ale has been poured and offered.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offering vessels, to the tune 《Feng'an》: fat victims have been cut apart and presented; the aromatic ale has been poured and offered.

translations.literal: The prayer text is also set forth; harmonious music now runs through all.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer text is also set forth; harmonious music now runs through all.

translations.literal: The sacrificial rites are fully performed; the withdrawal is duly carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial rites are fully performed; the withdrawal is duly carried out.

sentences.zh: 攝事十三首降神，《理安》肅肅清廟，昭事祖禰。

translations.literal: Thirteen hymns for the surrogate rite: inviting the spirits down, to the tune 《Lian》: solemn, solemn is the pure temple; we brightly serve the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen hymns for the surrogate rite: inviting the spirits down, to the tune 《Li'an》: solemn and still stands the pure temple; we brightly serve the ancestors.

translations.literal: The grain offerings are fragrant; from the four seas they come to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The grain offerings are fragrant; from the four seas they come to sacrifice.

translations.literal: The imperial spirits draw near in thought; their commanding presence is manifest.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial spirits draw near in thought; their commanding presence is manifest.

translations.literal: Blessings descend in abundance, that the age may endure forever.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings pour down without stint, that the line may flourish through endless ages.

sentences.zh: 太尉行，《正安》祼鬯溥將，賓屍在位。

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant's procession, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: the unmixed aromatic ale is broadly presented; the surrogate spirit-host takes his place.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant's procession, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: the unmixed aromatic ale is broadly presented; the spirit-proxy stands in his station.

translations.literal: The emperor's virtue rises and is heard; filial thought shines and spreads.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's virtue rises and is heard; filial devotion shines and spreads.

translations.literal: Dukes, ministers, various directors, tutors, charioteers, and masters.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes, ministers, various directors, tutors, charioteers, and masters.

translations.literal: Utmost sincerity moves the spirits; fortune and emolument come to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Utmost sincerity moves the spirits; fortune and blessing come to arrive.

sentences.zh: 奠瓚，《瑞安》淳清育物，瑞木成文。

translations.literal: Offering the libation vessel, to the tune 《Ruian》: pure clarity nurtures all things; the auspicious tree forms its pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Offering the libation vessel, to the tune 《Ruian》: pure clarity nurtures all things; the auspicious tree forms its pattern.

translations.literal: Primordial qi is shaped and refined; not smoke but dense, fragrant vapor.
translations.idiomatic: Primordial qi is shaped and refined; not smoke but dense, fragrant vapor.

translations.literal: The dark gift is manifestly received; supreme harmony is what we breathe.
translations.idiomatic: The dark gift is manifestly received; supreme harmony is what we breathe.

translations.literal: The ascending hymn and unmixed offering are presented; fragrance seems almost to be heard.
translations.idiomatic: The ascending hymn and unmixed offering are presented; fragrance seems almost to be heard.

translations.literal: Presenting the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》

translations.literal: Victims are cut on the patterned stone; they are roasted and cooked.
translations.idiomatic: Victims are cut on the patterned stone; they are roasted and cooked.

translations.literal: Abundant, large, fat, and plump—they are offered as delicacies to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant, large, fat, and plump—they are offered as delicacies to the spirits.

translations.literal: The ancestors draw near; they are feasted in full sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestors draw near; they are feasted in full sincerity.

translations.literal: As if we heard their gentle cough; we feast them and bring them peace.
translations.idiomatic: As if we heard their gentle breath; we feast them and bring them peace.

sentences.zh: 酌獻僖祖室，《大善》肅肅藝祖，肇基鴻源。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Xi, to the tune 《Dashan》: solemn, solemn is the Founding Ancestor; he opened the great source.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Xi, to the tune 《Dashan》: solemn, solemn is the Founding Ancestor; he opened the great source.

translations.literal: The beginning was vast and bright; like a swallow's wings he sheltered and bequeathed to descendants.
translations.idiomatic: The beginning was vast and bright; like a swallow's wings he sheltered and bequeathed to descendants.

translations.literal: The sacrifices endure forever; blessing flows to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifices endure forever; blessing flows to later generations.

translations.literal: His august spirit is in Heaven; he looks upon us and his thought remains.
translations.idiomatic: His august spirit is in Heaven; he looks upon us and his thought remains.

sentences.zh: 順祖室，《大寧》思文聖祖，長發其祥。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Shun, to the tune 《Daning》: reflect on the cultured sage ancestor; long has his auspice been sent forth.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Shun, to the tune 《Daning》: reflect on the cultured sage ancestor; long has his auspice been sent forth.

translations.literal: Bestowed bounty spreads and multiplies; thick virtue sends forth its light.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowed bounty spreads and multiplies; thick virtue sends forth its light.

translations.literal: The favored mandate comes from Heaven; the age to come is divined to flourish.
translations.idiomatic: The favored mandate comes from Heaven; the age to come is divined to flourish.

translations.literal: Reverently and solemnly we perform the filial offering; blessings descend without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently and solemnly we perform the filial offering; blessings descend without bound.

sentences.zh: 翼祖室，《大順》明明我祖，積德累仁。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Yi, to the tune 《Dashun》: bright, bright is our ancestor; he accumulated virtue and piled up benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Yi, to the tune 《Dashun》: bright, bright is our ancestor; he accumulated virtue and piled up benevolence.

translations.literal: He dwelt in obscurity and hid his brilliance; he advanced the seed and was ever diligent.
translations.idiomatic: He dwelt in obscurity and hid his brilliance; he advanced the line and was ever diligent.

translations.literal: The imperial design was Heaven-bestowed; its radiance renews day by day.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial design was Heaven-bestowed; its radiance renews day by day.

translations.literal: The ancestral temple is bustling; the bright service is jointly performed.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple is bustling; the bright service is jointly performed.

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Xuan, to the tune 《Daqing》
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Xuan, to the tune 《Daqing》

translations.literal: Mighty, mighty is our ancestor; in his time he was like an eagle soaring.
translations.idiomatic: Mighty, mighty is our ancestor; in his time he was like an eagle soaring.

translations.literal: His hidden virtue did not blaze forth; yet the source he opened was numinous and long.
translations.idiomatic: His hidden virtue did not blaze forth; yet the source he opened was numinous and long.

translations.literal: In the great classification he was paired with Heaven; forever we think of him and do not forget.
translations.idiomatic: In the great classification he was paired with Heaven; forever we think of him and do not forget.

translations.literal: He comes to look upon us and comes to feast; a hundred blessings are brought forward.
translations.idiomatic: He comes to look upon us and comes to feast; a hundred blessings are brought forward.

sentences.zh: 太祖室，《大定》赫赫太祖，受命於天。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Taizu, to the tune Dading: brilliant, brilliant is Emperor Taizu, receiving the mandate from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Taizu, to the tune Dading: brilliant, brilliant is Emperor Taizu, receiving the mandate from Heaven.

translations.literal: The crimson tally opened his fortune; his might extended to the eight directions.
translations.idiomatic: The crimson tally opened his fortune; his might extended to the eight directions.

translations.literal: By divine martial prowess he quelled disorder; his achievements admit no gap.
translations.idiomatic: By divine martial prowess he quelled disorder; his achievements admit no gap.

translations.literal: Solemnly he grandly succeeded; for a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly he grandly succeeded; for endless ages.

sentences.zh: 太宗室，《大盛》穆穆太宗，與天合德。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Taizong, to the tune Dasheng: solemn, solemn is Emperor Taizong, in virtue united with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Taizong, to the tune Dasheng: solemn, solemn is Emperor Taizong, in virtue united with Heaven.

translations.literal: Before dawn he grandly made manifest his virtue; diligent and reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn he grandly made manifest his virtue; diligent and reverent.

translations.literal: He spread blessing upon the people below; timely was the emperor's power.
translations.idiomatic: He spread blessing upon the people below; timely was the emperor's power.

translations.literal: Forever we cherish the sage spirit; filial thought knows no bound.
translations.idiomatic: Forever we cherish the sage spirit; filial devotion knows no bound.

sentences.zh: 真宗室，《大明》煌煌真宗，善繼善承。

translations.literal: The shrine of Emperor Zhenzong, to the tune Daming: radiant, radiant is Emperor Zhenzong, skilled at continuing and skilled at receiving.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine of Emperor Zhenzong, to the tune Daming: radiant, radiant is Emperor Zhenzong, skilled at continuing and skilled at receiving.

translations.literal: Through classic martial achievement he displayed virtue and reached the age of ordered peace.
translations.idiomatic: Through classic martial achievement he displayed virtue and reached the age of ordered peace.

translations.literal: Feng and si rites, ritual and music--greatly he made manifest his vast renown.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and si rites, ritual and music--greatly he made manifest his vast renown.

translations.literal: He ascended to be paired in the Literary Temple; the imperial design endures in peace.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended to be paired in the Literary Temple; the imperial design endures in peace.

translations.literal: Withdrawing the offering vessels, to the tune Feng'an
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offering vessels, to the tune Feng'an

translations.literal: The tripod stands are already set forth; the dou and bian vessels are already arranged.
translations.idiomatic: The tripod stands are already set forth; the dou and bian vessels are already arranged.

translations.literal: Metal and stone instruments are in the court; the craftsmen take their ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Metal and stone instruments are in the court; the craftsmen take their ranks.

translations.literal: The prepared objects are solemn; sincerity is displayed and purity attained.
translations.idiomatic: The prepared objects are solemn; sincerity is displayed and purity attained.

translations.literal: Filial piety is timely thought; the rite withdraws to Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Filial piety is timely thought; the rite withdraws to Yong.

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits away, to the tune Li'an
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, to the tune Li'an

sentences.zh: 神之來兮風肅然，神之去兮升九天。

translations.literal: When the spirit comes, the wind is solemn; when the spirit departs, it ascends the nine heavens.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit comes, the wind is solemn; when the spirit departs, it ascends the nine heavens.

sentences.zh: 排淩兢兮還恍惚，羽旄紛兮蕭燔煙。

translations.literal: Pushing through trembling awe, returning in trance; feathered banners in profusion, the smoke of burning offerings rises.
translations.idiomatic: Pushing through trembling awe, returning in trance; feathered banners in profusion, the smoke of burning offerings rises.

sentences.zh: 真宗御製二首奠瓚用《萬國朝天》鴻源浚發，睿圖誕彰。

translations.literal: Two hymns composed by Emperor Zhenzong for offering the libation vessel, to the tune Myriad States Pay Court to Heaven: the great source is dredged and sent forth; the sagely design is born and made manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Two hymns composed by Emperor Zhenzong for offering the libation vessel, to the tune Myriad States Pay Court to Heaven: the great source is dredged and sent forth; the sagely design is born and made manifest.

translations.literal: The lofty and bright bestow bounty; repeated harmony extends auspice.
translations.idiomatic: The lofty and bright bestow bounty; repeated harmony extends auspice.

translations.literal: Towering is the Founding Ancestor; broadly he leads all to attend as guest-kings.
translations.idiomatic: Towering is the Founding Ancestor; broadly he leads all to attend as guest-kings.

translations.literal: Radiant is the cultured father; the realm is greatly at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Radiant is the cultured father; the realm is greatly at peace.

translations.literal: Precious omens are manifest and bright; the precious calendar is long and enduring.
translations.idiomatic: Precious omens are manifest and bright; the precious calendar is long and enduring.

translations.literal: The nature of things flourishes and succeeds; folk customs are rich and prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: The nature of things flourishes and succeeds; folk customs are rich and prosperous.

translations.literal: In the great fields many crops; millet and grain are abundant.
translations.idiomatic: In the great fields many crops; millet and grain are abundant.

translations.literal: All living things receive fine nurture; birds and beasts move with stately step.
translations.idiomatic: All living things receive fine nurture; birds and beasts move with stately step.

translations.literal: The eight cords unify the domain; the nine garments reach to the distant wilds.
translations.idiomatic: The eight cords unify the domain; the nine garments reach to the distant wilds.

translations.idiomatic: The Way is trusted by the spirits; spirits and numina rest at ease.

translations.literal: Wine has fine virtue; things are only as their season.
translations.idiomatic: Wine has fine virtue; each thing comes in its season.

translations.literal: Slow tempo and peaceful song; music is played, all fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Slow tempo, peaceful song; the music is wholly fitting.

translations.literal: Joyfully they rejoice in health; fortune and blessing are brought to peace.
translations.idiomatic: Joyfully they rejoice in peace; fortune and blessing are brought to rest.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《豐安》王假有廟，子孫保光。

translations.literal: Presenting the stands, to the tune Feng'an: the king arrives at the temple; descendants preserve its glory.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the stands, to the tune Feng'an: the king comes to the temple; descendants preserve its glory.

translations.literal: Presenting the victim to announce; the jade stand is rich with fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: The victim is presented in announcement; the jade stand is rich with fragrance.

translations.literal: With single-minded focus and stern intent, may the spirits guide the tasting.
translations.idiomatic: With focused mind and stern intent, may the spirits guide the tasting.

translations.literal: Beautifully receiving the spirits' intent, they extend blessing without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Beautifully receiving the spirits' intent, they extend blessing without bound.

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗，《正安》恪恭祀典，涓選休成。

translations.literal: First offering, hand-washing, to the tune Zheng'an: reverently performing the canonical sacrifice, selecting and completing the auspicious observance.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, hand-washing, to the tune Zheng'an: reverently performing the canonical rite, choosing and completing the auspicious observance.

translations.literal: The wash is set out to attain purity, directly at the eastern wing.
translations.idiomatic: The wash is set for purity, directly at the eastern wing.

translations.literal: Fine ale is reverently presented; bright virtue is fragrant alone.
translations.idiomatic: Fine ale is reverently offered; bright virtue alone is fragrant.

translations.literal: Ancestors and fathers come to draw near; we feast them with this filial sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors and fathers draw near; we feast them with this filial sincerity.

sentences.zh: 升殿，《正安》冠佩雍容，時惟上公。

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, to the tune Zheng'an: caps and sashes are dignified and at ease; the time is for the chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, to the tune Zheng'an: caps and sashes dignified and at ease—the chief minister's hour.

translations.literal: Feasting in the pure temple; ascending and descending are ever more reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Feasting in the pure temple; every ascent and descent grows more reverent.

translations.literal: Baskets and stands are quietly fine; grain offerings are pure and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and stands rest in quiet beauty; grain offerings pure and abundant.

translations.literal: The filial grandson has cause for celebration; ten thousand blessings come together.
translations.idiomatic: The filial grandson rejoices; ten thousand blessings gather as one.

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Xizu, to the tune Jiming
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering to Emperor Xizu's shrine, to the tune Jiming

translations.literal: Solemn and still is the Cultured Founder; from Heaven auspice was sent forth.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and still is the Cultured Founder; from Heaven auspice arose.

translations.literal: He laid the foundation of the bright mandate; bestowed bounty is without bound.
translations.idiomatic: He laid the bright mandate's foundation; bestowed bounty knows no bound.

translations.literal: Descendants by the hundred million; the altars of state are numinous and long.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants by the hundred million; state altars numinous and enduring.

translations.literal: When the spirits draw near in thought, it is as if they were present, vast and ample.
translations.idiomatic: When spirits draw near in thought, it is as if they were present, vast and ample.

sentences.zh: 宣祖室酌獻，《天元》天啟炎曆，集我大命。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Xuanzu, to the tune Tianyuan: Heaven opened the fiery reign; our great mandate was gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Xuanzu's shrine, to the tune Tianyuan: Heaven opened the fiery reign and gathered our great mandate.

translations.literal: Long sent forth was its auspice; solemnly was born the supreme sage.
translations.idiomatic: Long its auspice was sent forth; solemnly the supreme sage was born.

translations.literal: Barbarian disorder was mown and the wilds cleared; Heaven and Earth were thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarian disorder was cut down and the wilds cleared; Heaven and Earth were settled.

translations.literal: Seasonal rites were then cultivated; the filial grandson has cause for celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal rites were then perfected; the filial grandson rejoices.

sentences.zh: 太祖室酌獻，《皇武》赫赫藝祖，受天明命。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Taizu, to the tune Huangwu: brilliant, brilliant is the Founding Ancestor; he received Heaven's bright mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Taizu's shrine, to the tune Huangwu: brilliant is the Founding Ancestor, who received Heaven's bright mandate.

translations.literal: His might extended to the eight cords; his virtue was bequeathed to successive sages.
translations.idiomatic: His might reached the eight directions; his virtue passed to sage after sage.

translations.literal: Sacrificial affairs are brightly accomplished; solemn are the sheng and qing.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial affairs shine bright; sheng and qing sound with solemnity.

translations.literal: Facing Heaven in response; extended rest and bestowed celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Facing Heaven in response; rest extended, celebration bestowed.

sentences.zh: 太宗室酌獻，《大定》明明在上，時維太宗。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Taizong, to the tune Dading: bright and manifest on high; the season was Emperor Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Taizong's shrine, to the tune Dading: bright on high—in his season stood Emperor Taizong.

translations.literal: Truly martial, truly cultured; the great foundation was continued and raised.
translations.idiomatic: Truly martial, truly cultured; the great foundation was carried on and raised.

translations.literal: In the solemn pure temple, bright repayment is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: In the solemn pure temple, bright repayment flows in abundance.

translations.literal: The imperial numina draw near in thought; fortune and blessing come together.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial spirits draw near in thought; fortune and blessing gather as one.

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Zhenzong, to the tune Xiwen
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering to Emperor Zhenzong's shrine, to the tune Xiwen

translations.literal: Solemn and still is the True Emperor; his blazing merit has its light.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and still is the True Emperor; his blazing merit shines bright.

translations.literal: Greatly he inherited the two sovereigns; broadly he settled the ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly he followed the two sovereigns and broadly settled the realm.

translations.literal: His might extended to the Rong and Di; his Way matched the vaulted heavens.
translations.idiomatic: His might reached the barbarian frontiers; his Way matched the vaulted sky.

translations.literal: He rejoices in timely burnt offerings; blessing descends without bound.
translations.idiomatic: He rejoices in timely sacrifices; blessing descends without bound.

sentences.zh: 仁宗室酌獻，《美成》至哉帝德，乃聖乃神！

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Renzong, to the tune Meicheng: supreme is the emperor's virtue—he is sage, he is divine!
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Renzong's shrine, to the tune Meicheng: supreme is the emperor's virtue—sage and divine!

translations.literal: With reverent self-discipline he faced south; all under Heaven returned to benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently he faced south; all under Heaven returned to benevolence.

translations.literal: His reign years were long; he bequeathed abundance to those who came after.
translations.idiomatic: His years were long; abundance he bequeathed to posterity.

translations.literal: Rites were cultivated according to the old canon; the precious mandate was renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were perfected per the ancient canon; the precious mandate was renewed.

sentences.zh: 英宗室酌獻，《治隆》炎基克鞏，赫赫英宗。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Yingzong, to the tune Zhilong: the fiery foundation was firmly secured; brilliant, brilliant is Heroic Emperor Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Yingzong's shrine, to the tune Zhilong: the fiery foundation was secured; brilliant is Heroic Emperor Yingzong.

translations.literal: He continued the blessing of former blazing merit; benevolent transformation grew ever greater.
translations.idiomatic: He continued former glory; benevolent rule grew ever greater.

sentences.zh: 篤生聖子，堯、湯比蹤，烝嚐萬世，福祿來崇。

translations.literal: Solemnly was born a sage son; Yao and Tang are matched in his traces; sacrifices for ten thousand generations; fortune and blessing come in lofty abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly a sage son was born, treading Yao and Tang's path; for ten thousand generations the offerings rise; fortune and blessing heap high.

sentences.zh: 神宗室酌獻，《大明》於昭神祖，運撫明昌。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Shenzong, to the tune Daming: manifest is the divine ancestor; his fortune stroked bright prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Shenzong's shrine, to the tune Daming: manifest is the divine ancestor; his fortune nurtured bright prosperity.

translations.literal: He began anew the hundred measures; he could match the Three Kings.
translations.idiomatic: He renewed the hundred measures; he could match the Three Kings.

translations.literal: In distant wilds his merit reached the bottom; sage martial prowess was raised on high.
translations.idiomatic: In distant wilds his merit was laid; sage martial prowess was raised high.

translations.literal: Forever we sing "Zhi Jing"; the Supreme Lord is sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Forever we chant Zhi Jing; the Supreme Lord is sovereign.

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Zhezong, to the tune Chongguang
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering to Emperor Zhezong's shrine, to the tune Chongguang

translations.literal: August is the deep and wise ruler; swiftly his renown had sound.
translations.idiomatic: August is the deep and wise ruler; swiftly his renown resounded.

translations.literal: He followed the season of his illustrious father; greatly he displayed model conduct.
translations.idiomatic: He followed his illustrious father's season; greatly he displayed model conduct.

translations.literal: His merit brightened the great enterprise; his Way accorded with the three numina.
translations.idiomatic: His merit brightened the great enterprise; his Way accorded with the three spirits.

translations.literal: Forever may his heirs be at peace; may they come in ease and come in rest.
translations.idiomatic: Forever peace to his heirs; may they come in ease and in rest.

sentences.zh: 徽宗室酌獻，《承元》天錫神聖，徽柔懿恭。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the shrine of Emperor Huizong, to the tune Chengyuan: Heaven bestowed sacred divinity; subtle gentleness and virtuous reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Huizong's shrine, to the tune Chengyuan: Heaven bestowed sacred divinity; subtle, gentle, and reverent.

translations.literal: Draped robes, hands joined in courtesy; following institutions, spreading merit.
translations.idiomatic: Robes draped, hands joined; he followed the laws and spread their merit.

translations.literal: Paired with Heaven he established the pole; embodying the Way he stood at the center.
translations.idiomatic: Paired with Heaven he set the pole; embodying the Way he stood at the center.

translations.literal: Bless our heroic father; ten thousand fortunes gather as one.
translations.idiomatic: Bless our heroic father; ten thousand fortunes gather as one.

sentences.zh: 欽宗室，《端慶》於皇欽宗，道備德宏。

translations.literal: Emperor Qinzong's shrine, to the tune Duanqing: august is Emperor Qinzong; the Way is complete and virtue vast.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Qinzong's shrine, to the tune Duanqing: august is Emperor Qinzong—the Way complete, virtue vast.

translations.literal: Truly reverent, truly frugal; able to classify, able to illumine.
translations.idiomatic: Truly reverent, truly frugal; discerning and illumining.

translations.literal: Filial piety followed former blazing merit; benevolence assisted all that lives in the case.
translations.idiomatic: Filial piety followed former glory; benevolence supported all that lives.

translations.literal: They rejoice in this great sacrifice; forever at ease in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: They rejoice in this great sacrifice; forever at rest in the ancestral shrine.

sentences.zh: 高宗室，《大德》於皇時宋，自天保定。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong's shrine, to the tune Dade: august is Song in its season; from Heaven comes security and peace.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong's shrine, to the tune Dade: august is Song in its time; from Heaven comes preservation.

translations.literal: Gaozong received it; again the bright mandate was prostrated and restored.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong received it; the bright mandate rose anew.

translations.literal: He continued and opened the restoration; he winged goodness and transmitted sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the restoration; he winged goodness and passed on sage rule.

translations.literal: For how many thousands of years; forever may his celebration be at peace.
translations.idiomatic: For endless thousands of years; may his celebration endure in peace.

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong's shrine, to the tune Dalun
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong's shrine, to the tune Dalun

translations.literal: Of the sage's virtue, none surpasses filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Of the sage's virtue, nothing surpasses filial piety.

translations.literal: Reflect on august Emperor Xiaozong; in conduct he established teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Reflect on august Emperor Xiaozong—he established teaching through his conduct.

translations.literal: From first to last pure in sincerity—not merely in smiling countenance.
translations.idiomatic: From first to last pure in sincerity—not mere smiling looks.

translations.literal: For ten thousand years, this is the model, this is what to emulate.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years, this is the model to follow.

sentences.zh: 光宗室，《大和》維宋洽熙，帝繼於理。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangzong's shrine, to the tune Dahe: Song is harmoniously radiant; the emperor succeeded through principle.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangzong's shrine, to the tune Dahe: Song shines in harmony; the emperor succeeded through principle.

translations.literal: The ten thousand clans received thick life; the three luminaries followed their tracks.
translations.idiomatic: All clans thrived; sun, moon, and stars held their courses.

translations.literal: Responding to the season, Heaven's blessing; thereby at ease, winging the sons.
translations.idiomatic: Responding to the seasons, Heaven's blessing wings his sons in ease.

translations.literal: Solemn chant and harmonious sound; may the spirits have joy.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn chant and harmony; may the spirits rejoice.

sentences.zh: 文舞退、武舞進，《正安》肅肅清廟，於顯維德。

translations.literal: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances, to the tune Zheng'an: solemn, solemn is the pure temple; manifest is its virtue alone.
translations.idiomatic: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances, to the tune Zheng'an: solemn is the pure temple—manifest is its virtue.

translations.literal: Our sacrifice is wholly timely; our performance has wings.
translations.idiomatic: Our sacrifice is wholly timely; our music soars with wings.

translations.literal: Bearing pheasant plumes, carrying swiftness; there come shield and battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing pheasant plumes, swift in motion; shield and axe arrive.

translations.literal: The spirits are at ease; auspicious rest truly draws near.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits rest at ease; auspicious fortune truly draws near.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《文安》觀德宗祏，奕世烈光。

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, to the tune Wen'an: contemplating the shrine of the ancestral temple; generation after generation blazing light.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary and final offerings, to the tune Wen'an: we contemplate the ancestral shrine; age after age blazing light.

translations.literal: There is a solemn sacrificial canon; thereby we follow the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: The solemn canon stands; we follow the old statutes.

translations.literal: Music harmonizes in nine changes; the offering raises the repeated goblet.
translations.idiomatic: Music harmonizes in nine changes; offerings raise the layered goblet.

translations.literal: At ease as if present; abundant blessing heaps high.
translations.idiomatic: At ease as if they were present; blessing heaps high.

translations.literal: Removing the dishes, to the tune Gong'an
translations.idiomatic: Removing the dishes, to the tune Gong'an

translations.literal: Rites are complete and music fulfilled; the offerings declare sincerity utterly spent.
translations.idiomatic: Rite and music complete; every offering declares sincerity spent utterly.

translations.literal: Mutually assisting are the feudal lords; spirits and men rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords assist one another; spirits and men rejoice.

translations.literal: They sing one section of "Yong"; the various stewards then withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: They sing one stanza of Yong; the stewards then withdraw the offerings.

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven for ten thousand generations; no rival to his blazing merit.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven for ten thousand generations—none rival his blazing merit.

sentences.zh: 送神，《興安》霜露既降，時思展禋。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits away, to the tune Xing'an: frost and dew have already fallen; timely thought extends the burnt offering.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, to the tune Xing'an: frost and dew have fallen; timely thought extends the burnt offering.

translations.literal: Those in Heaven's carriage, with a turn regard and rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Those in Heaven's court turn and regard us with joy.

translations.literal: Music fulfilled, rites complete; words of return never cease.
translations.idiomatic: Music and rite complete; words of return never cease.

translations.literal: Already at peace, already joyful; fortune and blessing come to fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: Already at peace, already joyful; fortune and blessing come to completion.

sentences.zh: 袷享八首迎神，《興安》黃鍾宮

translations.literal: Eight hymns for the xia offering—inviting the spirits, to the tune Xing'an, Huangzhong as gong
translations.idiomatic: Eight hymns for the xia offering—inviting the spirits, to the tune Xing'an, Huangzhong as gong

translations.literal: The season is early winter; frost and dew have already fallen.
translations.idiomatic: It is early winter; frost and dew have fallen.

translations.literal: The great combined feast rite; according to the season it is performed.
translations.idiomatic: The great combined feast is held; according to season it proceeds.

translations.literal: Filial hearts flutter with care; only that the spirits come and rest.
translations.idiomatic: Filial hearts quiver with care; may the spirits come and rest.

translations.literal: Solemnly the hymn leads this observance; the spirits all heed and listen.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly the hymn leads; the spirits all heed and listen.

sentences.zh: 大呂角於穆孝思，嘉薦維時。

translations.literal: Dalü as jue: solemn and still is filial thought; fine offerings at the proper season.
translations.idiomatic: Dalü as jue: solemn is filial thought; fine offerings at the proper season.

translations.literal: Sincerity penetrates and draws them here; all come in ease.
translations.idiomatic: Sincerity penetrates; all come to rest at ease.

translations.literal: The spirits heed it; they extend blessing in abundant measure.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits heed; they extend blessing in abundance.

translations.literal: For ten thousand years, forever guarding the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years, forever guarding the great foundation.

sentences.zh: 太簇徵於昭孝治，通乎神明。

translations.literal: Taicu as zhi: manifest is filial governance; it penetrates to spirits and numina.
translations.idiomatic: Taicu as zhi: manifest is filial rule; it reaches spirits and numina.

translations.literal: Cold and heat do not err; the radiant affair is fully accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Cold and heat hold true; the radiant rite stands complete.

translations.literal: Victims pure and plump are grand; millet and panicled millet are fragrant alone.
translations.idiomatic: Victims are pure and plump; millet and panicled millet are fragrant.

translations.literal: With feasting and with sacrifice; they come at ease, they come to rest.
translations.idiomatic: We feast and sacrifice; they come at ease, they come to rest.

sentences.zh: 應鍾羽芬孝祀，薦灌肅雍。

translations.literal: Yingzhong as yu: fragrant is the filial sacrifice; libation offerings, solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhong as yu: fragrant the filial sacrifice; libations, solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: Exerting effort toward the spirits; bright trust all penetrates.
translations.idiomatic: We strive toward the spirits; bright trust penetrates all.

translations.literal: The spirits rest and remain; they favor us with vast blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits rest and remain; vast blessing favors us.

translations.literal: Widely spread across ten thousand dwellings; fortune and blessing gather as one.
translations.idiomatic: Spread across ten thousand dwellings; fortune and blessing gather as one.

translations.literal: First offering to Emperor Shunzu, libation offering, to the tune Daning
translations.idiomatic: First offering to Emperor Shunzu, libation offering, to the tune Daning

translations.literal: Brilliant, brilliant is the imperial ancestor; he dredged and sent forth auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Brilliant is the imperial ancestor; he dredged forth auspice.

translations.literal: Virtue abundant flows far; generation after generation grows ever more flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue flows far; generation after generation grows more flourishing.

translations.literal: The filial grandson has cause for celebration; fine offerings, excellent fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: The filial grandson rejoices; fine offerings, excellent fragrance.

translations.literal: The spirit protector is thereby feasted; bestowed bounty without bound.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit protector is feasted; bestowed bounty without bound.

sentences.zh: 翼祖酌獻，《興安》上天眷命，佑我丕基。

translations.literal: Libation offering to Emperor Yizu, to the tune Xing'an: Heaven favors the mandate, blesses our great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Yizu's shrine, to the tune Xing'an: Heaven favors the mandate and blesses our great foundation.

translations.literal: Careful, careful is the imperial ancestor; he does not blaze his radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Careful is the imperial ancestor; he does not blaze his radiance.

translations.literal: Accumulated thickness flows long; fortune and blessing are fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Depth accumulated flows long; fortune and blessing are fitting.

translations.literal: Sacrificial affairs are wholly timely; the great-grandson performs them with devotion.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial affairs are wholly timely; the great-grandson is devoted to them.

sentences.zh: 光宗室酌獻，《大承》於皇光宗，握符禦極。

translations.literal: Libation offering to Emperor Guangzong's shrine, to the tune Dacheng: august is Emperor Guangzong; he grasped the tally and reached the pole.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Guangzong's shrine, to the tune Dacheng: august is Emperor Guangzong—he grasped the tally and reached the throne.

translations.literal: Manifest is his succession; only benevolence and virtue!
translations.idiomatic: Manifest his succession—only benevolence and virtue!

translations.literal: Diligently he bestowed on the people; never had he leisure or rest.
translations.idiomatic: Diligently he gave to the people; never a moment's rest.

translations.literal: Thought for ten thousand years; forever he laid foundation in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Thought for ten thousand years; forever he secured the ancestral shrine.

sentences.zh: 送神，《興安》合祭大事，因時發天。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits away, to the tune Xing'an: the great combined sacrifice; according to the season Heaven is aroused.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, to the tune Xing'an: the great combined sacrifice rouses Heaven in its season.

translations.literal: Careful, careful is filial thought; three offerings, rites reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Careful filial thought; three offerings, rites reverent.

translations.literal: Spirits, ah—joy and peace; whirlwind carriage speaks of returning.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits, rejoice in peace; whirlwind carriage turns homeward.

translations.literal: Forever spirits for those who come after; for thousands of ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Forever spirits for posterity; for thousands upon thousands of years.

translations.literal: One hymn for bestowing honorific titles upon Emperor Renzong and Emperor Yingzong
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for bestowing honorific titles upon Emperor Renzong and Emperor Yingzong

sentences.zh: 入門升殿，《顯安》於穆仁祖，寵綏萬方。

translations.literal: Entering the gate, ascending the hall, to the tune Xian'an: solemn and still is the Benevolent Ancestor; favored grace soothes the ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the gate, ascending the hall, to the tune Xian'an: solemn is the Benevolent Ancestor; favored grace soothes the realm.

translations.literal: "Zhi Jing" for the heroic father; in the end he used Cheng and Kang as models.
translations.idiomatic: We chant Zhi Jing for the heroic father; in the end he matched Cheng and Kang.

translations.literal: The chart of insignia and precious book; blazing is its light.
translations.idiomatic: Insignia chart and precious register blaze with light.

translations.literal: May it approach a hundred million years; with Heaven, without bound.
translations.idiomatic: May it last a hundred million years, boundless as Heaven.

translations.literal: One hymn for bestowing an honorific title upon Emperor Yingzong
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for bestowing an honorific title upon Emperor Yingzong

sentences.zh: 入門，《正安》在宋五世，天子神明。

translations.literal: Entering the gate, to the tune Zheng'an: in Song's fifth generation, the Son of Heaven is divine and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the gate, to the tune Zheng'an: in Song's fifth generation the Son of Heaven is divine and bright.

translations.literal: The assembly of lords presents the register; then they raise the great name.
translations.idiomatic: The lords present the register and proclaim the great honorific name.

translations.literal: Golden writing blaze-bright; forthwith manifests its completion.
translations.idiomatic: Golden characters blaze forth, proclaiming the rite's completion.

translations.literal: Reflect on Heaven's many blessings; with Heaven, the same voice.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Heaven's many blessings, our voice unites with Heaven.

translations.literal: One hymn for elevating the honorific title of Emperor Shenzong
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for elevating the honorific title of Emperor Shenzong

translations.literal: Opening corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: Opening section mark

translations.literal: (Composed in the Zhezong reign) closing corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: (Composed in the Zhezong reign) closing section mark

sentences.zh: 升殿，《顯安》於惟禰廟，乃聖乃神。

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, to the tune Xian'an: O thou ancestral temple—both sage and divine.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, to the tune Xian'an: O ancestral temple—sacred and divine.

translations.literal: Men who uphold culture; arising, only renewal.
translations.idiomatic: Men of culture arise to renew all things.

translations.literal: Building the palace, examining antiquity; one regard, same benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Palaces built after antiquity; all treated with equal benevolence.

translations.literal: May we approach complete titles, to enjoy Heaven and mankind.
translations.idiomatic: May full honorific titles be complete, to offer to Heaven and man.

sentences.zh: 紹興十四年奉上徽宗冊寶三首

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Shaoxing, presenting Emperor Huizong's register and seals—three hymns
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing year 14: three hymns presenting Emperor Huizong's register and seals

sentences.zh: 冊賓入門，《顯安》於鑠徽考，如天莫名。

translations.literal: The register envoy enters the gate, to the tune Xian'an: how radiant the honored father; like Heaven, name beyond naming.
translations.idiomatic: The register envoy enters the gate, to the tune Xian'an: how radiant our honored father—like Heaven, beyond all naming.

translations.literal: Now at this great raising, we match pure essence and refinement.
translations.idiomatic: Now raised on high, we match pure essence and refinement.

translations.literal: Warm jade carved with writing; it comes to the side altar.
translations.idiomatic: Warm jade carved with text arrives at the side altar.

translations.literal: Solemn and stately; rites complete, music accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and stately—the rites complete, the music fulfilled.

translations.literal: Register and seals ascend the hall, to the tune Xian'an
translations.idiomatic: Register and seals ascend the hall, to the tune Xian'an

translations.literal: Golden characters blaze-bright; jade radiance gleams and gleams.
translations.idiomatic: Golden characters blaze; jade radiance gleams.

translations.literal: The assembly of officers presents them; they ascend this precious hall.
translations.idiomatic: Officers present them, ascending this precious hall.

translations.literal: Responding in homage to the ancestors; in manner following established statutes.
translations.idiomatic: We answer the ancestors in homage, following established statutes.

translations.literal: Majesty and spirit are in Heaven; they come, they rest; they come, they feast.
translations.idiomatic: Majesty and spirit in Heaven—come to rest, come to feast.

sentences.zh: 上徽號，《顯安》惟精惟一，乃聖乃神。

translations.literal: Bestowing the honorific title, to the tune Xian'an: sole refinement and unity—both sage and divine.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowing the honorific title, to the tune Xian'an: sole refinement and unity—sacred and divine.

translations.literal: The great name can be raised; abundant merit is the guest.
translations.idiomatic: The great name is raised; abundant merit is honored.

translations.literal: Like Yu's achievement; like Yao's benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Like Yu in achievement, like Yao in benevolence.

translations.literal: Filial thought forever yearned; used to proclaim without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Filial longing endures, proclaimed without bound.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十五年上高宗徽號三首冊寶入門，《顯安》於穆高皇，功德兼隆。

translations.literal: Chunxi year 15, bestowing Emperor Gaozong's honorific title—three hymns; register and seals enter the gate, to the tune Xian'an: solemn and still is the High Emperor; merit and virtue both lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi year 15: three hymns for Emperor Gaozong's honorific title; register and seals enter the gate, to the tune Xian'an—solemn is the High Emperor, merit and virtue supreme.

translations.literal: Naming Heaven in the eulogy; the first posthumous title was not yet exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven is named in the eulogy; the first posthumous title was not yet exalted.

translations.literal: We consult the ritual canon; we raise the insignia and let the great name hang down.
translations.idiomatic: We consult the ritual canon, raising the insignia and proclaiming the great name.

translations.literal: On the chosen day's auspice, we ascend and advance to the temple palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the chosen auspicious day we ascend to the temple palace.

sentences.zh: 冊寶升殿，《顯安》有彖斯寶，有編斯冊。

translations.literal: Register and seals ascend the hall, to the tune Xian'an: there is the great seal, this treasure; there is the compilation, this register.
translations.idiomatic: Register and seals ascend the hall, to the tune Xian'an: here is the great seal, here the compiled register.

translations.literal: Led by banners and halberds; performed with metal and stone.
translations.idiomatic: Led by banners and halberds, accompanied by metal and stone.

translations.literal: Solemn majesty, full bearing; blaze-bright and illustrious.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn majesty in full splendor—blaze-bright and illustrious.

translations.literal: Ministers and officers present them; the lofty spirits come to approach.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers present them; the lofty spirits draw near.

sentences.zh: 上徽號，《顯安》中興之烈，高掩商宗。

translations.literal: Bestowing the honorific title, to the tune Xian'an: the glory of restoration—high, covering the Shang ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowing the honorific title, to the tune Xian'an: the glory of restoration towers above the Shang ancestor.

translations.literal: The beauty of yielding the throne; matching the elevation of Fang Xun.
translations.idiomatic: The beauty of abdication matches the elevation of Fang Xun.

translations.literal: Sixteen characters; matched to his form and bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen characters match his form and bearing.

translations.literal: Majesty and spirit are in Heaven; enriching posterity without end.
translations.idiomatic: Majesty and spirit in Heaven enrich posterity without end.

sentences.zh: 慶元三年奉上孝宗徽號三首

translations.literal: In the third year of Qingyuan, presenting Emperor Xiaozong's honorific title—three hymns
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan year 3: three hymns presenting Emperor Xiaozong's honorific title

sentences.zh: 冊寶入門，《顯安》巍巍孝廟，聖德天通。

translations.literal: Register and seals enter the gate, to the tune Xian'an: lofty, lofty is the Filial Temple; sage virtue connects with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Register and seals enter the gate, to the tune Xian'an: lofty is the Filial Temple—sage virtue reaches Heaven.

translations.literal: Matching the talisman of the Artistic Ancestor; able to continue Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: He matches the Artistic Ancestor and continues Emperor Gaozong.

translations.literal: There are rites and there is a register; we bear them forward, we exalt them.
translations.idiomatic: With rites and register we bear them forward and exalt them.

translations.literal: Jade carved, gold bound; they ascend to be presented at the spirit tablet palace.
translations.idiomatic: Jade carved and gold bound, presented at the spirit-tablet palace.

translations.literal: Register and seals ascend the hall, to the tune Xian'an
translations.idiomatic: Register and seals ascend the hall, to the tune Xian'an

translations.literal: Patterned gold glistens; register jade gleams moist.
translations.idiomatic: Patterned gold glistens; jade register gleams moist.

translations.literal: Succession continues Yao; virtue is complete in Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Succession continues Yao; virtue completes Shun.

translations.literal: Diligently exalting and raising high; sons filial, grandsons obedient.
translations.idiomatic: Diligently we exalt him; sons are filial, grandsons obedient.

translations.literal: Crowning virtue among the hundred kings; ten thousand years, instruction hangs down.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue crowns the hundred kings; for ten thousand years his teaching endures.

sentences.zh: 上徽號，《顯安》金石充庭，珩璜在列。

translations.literal: Bestowing the honorific title, to the tune Xian'an: metal and stone fill the court; pendant jades are ranged in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowing the honorific title, to the tune Xian'an: metal and stone fill the court; pendant jades stand in rows.

translations.literal: Painting Heaven and Earth; portraying sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth are painted; sun and moon portrayed.

translations.literal: Lofty, lofty merit and virtue; manifest, manifest counsels and achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty merit and virtue; manifest counsels and achievements.

translations.literal: Hanging down a hundred million years; the great insignia blaze-bright and raised.
translations.idiomatic: For a hundred million years the great insignia blaze forth.

sentences.zh: 高宗郊祀前朝享太廟三十首皇帝入門，《乾安》

translations.literal: Thirty hymns for Emperor Gaozong's suburban sacrifice, prior court offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the emperor enters the gate, to the tune Qian'an
translations.idiomatic: Thirty hymns for Emperor Gaozong's suburban sacrifice and prior court offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the emperor enters the gate, to the tune Qian'an

translations.idiomatic: Opening section mark

translations.literal: (Returning afterward to the front hall—the same throughout) closing corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: (Returning afterward to the front hall—the same throughout) closing section mark

translations.literal: O august is our sovereign; reverent caution, sole refinement.
translations.idiomatic: O august is our sovereign—reverent, cautious, wholly refined.

translations.literal: Arriving at the temple; ancestors and fathers are received.
translations.idiomatic: He comes to the temple to receive ancestors and fathers.

translations.literal: Hastening forward, only solemn; as if seeing them, thinking only sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: He hastens forward in solemnity, as if seeing them, thinking only sincerity.

translations.literal: May the spirits listen; come to feast, come to rest.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits hear—come to feast, come to rest.

translations.literal: The emperor ascends the hall, to the tune Qian'an
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascends the hall, to the tune Qian'an

translations.idiomatic: Opening section mark

translations.literal: (Proceeding to the chamber, descending the hall—the same throughout) closing corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: (Proceeding to the chamber, descending the hall—the same throughout) closing section mark

translations.literal: August, august great palace; greatly manifest, solemn and still.
translations.idiomatic: August great palace—greatly manifest, solemn and still.

translations.literal: Beautiful virtue blaze-bright and clear; primal qi returns and is restored.
translations.idiomatic: Beautiful virtue shines clear; primal qi is restored.

translations.literal: Fungus leaves spread lush; cassia blossoms assist with wings.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred fungus spreads lush; cassia blossoms spread their wings.

translations.literal: The filial grandson arrives here; he receives this great blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The filial grandson comes here and receives this great blessing.

sentences.zh: 盥洗，《乾安》維皇齊精，鬷假於廟。

translations.literal: Ritual washing, to the tune Qian'an: the sovereign alone is pure in refinement; he arrives at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual washing, to the tune Qian'an: the sovereign is wholly refined; he comes to the temple.

translations.literal: Beholding the beginning of washing; only with purity he announces.
translations.idiomatic: Beholding the first washing, he announces with purity alone.

translations.literal: Joyfully receiving the ancestors; compassionate sacrifice manifests filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Joyfully he receives the ancestors; compassionate sacrifice manifests filial piety.

translations.literal: Sincere heart has trust; great blessing is the response.
translations.idiomatic: Sincere heart finds trust; great blessing is granted in return.

translations.literal: Welcoming the spirits, to the tune Xing'an
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the spirits, to the tune Xing'an

translations.literal: Black millet fragrant wine is already presented; yellow bell fully performed.
translations.idiomatic: Black millet wine is presented; the yellow bell fully sounded.

translations.literal: Solemn are our ancestors and fathers; reverent and trembling, they wait.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn are our ancestors and fathers—reverent, they wait.

translations.literal: They oversee and behold here; cloud chariots come down.
translations.idiomatic: They oversee from here; cloud chariots descend.

sentences.zh: 尚書奉俎，《豐安》有碩其牲，登於大房。

translations.literal: The Minister of Works presents the stand, to the tune Feng'an: there is a fat victim; it ascends to the great room.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Works presents the stand, to the tune Feng'an: a fat victim ascends to the great room.

translations.literal: Solemnly displayed to offer enjoyment; may we approach guided tasting.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly displayed for offering; may guided tasting be granted.

translations.literal: It is not fatness that is announced; our people will be at peace.
translations.idiomatic: We announce not mere fatness—may our people be at peace.

translations.literal: Protect and nurture you who come after; let blessing hang down without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Protect posterity; let blessing endure without bound.

sentences.zh: 皇帝再盥洗，《乾安》盥至於再，潔誠愈孚。

translations.literal: The emperor washes again, to the tune Qian'an: washing reaches the second time; pure sincerity grows more trusted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor washes again, to the tune Qian'an: washed a second time, pure sincerity grows ever more trusted.

translations.literal: The emperor reverently presents; spirits all rejoice in fine care.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reverently presents; the spirits rejoice in fine blessing.

translations.literal: Rising songs proclaim joy; they gather at the vermilion hall.
translations.idiomatic: Rising songs proclaim joy; all gather at the vermilion hall.

translations.literal: Beholding his solemn bearing; receiving the talisman of blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Beholding his solemn bearing, we receive the sign of blessing.

sentences.zh: 僖祖室酌獻，《基命》思文僖祖，基德之元。

translations.literal: Offering libation at the shrine of Ancestor Xi, to the tune Jiming: reflect on the cultured Ancestor Xi; the origin of founding virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at Ancestor Xi's shrine, to the tune Jiming: mindful of cultured Ancestor Xi—origin of founding virtue.

translations.literal: August and martial, great is he; he received the mandate from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: August and martial, great—he received Heaven's mandate.

translations.literal: Accumulated thickness sends forth light; unceasing is its transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Deep accumulation sends forth light; its transmission never ceases.

translations.literal: The great-grandson is earnest in it; for ten thousand such years.
translations.idiomatic: The great-grandson is earnest—for ten thousand years.

translations.literal: Offering libation at the shrine of Ancestor Yi, to the tune Dashun
translations.idiomatic: Libation at Ancestor Yi's shrine, to the tune Dashun

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate has an opening; only benevolence is relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate opens; only benevolence is relied upon.

translations.literal: Then he rolled up the Ji region; thereby he turned to regard it.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered the Ji region and turned to regard it.

translations.literal: His turning to regard—what was it?
translations.idiomatic: What did he turn to regard?

translations.literal: Sending forth auspice, founding the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Sending forth auspice, founding the realm.

translations.literal: Bestowed upon sons and grandsons; reverently they uphold filial thought.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowed on sons and grandsons who reverently uphold filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 宣祖室，《天元》昭哉皇祖，源深流長！

translations.literal: Shrine of Ancestor Xuan, to the tune Tianyuan: manifest is the august ancestor; source deep, flow long!
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Xuan's shrine, to the tune Tianyuan: manifest is the august ancestor—source deep, flow long!

translations.literal: Carved halberds, jade libation vessels; beautiful, there is blazing light.
translations.idiomatic: Carved halberds, jade libation vessels—beautiful, blazing light.

translations.literal: Heaven blesses hidden virtue; continuing the age, it flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven blesses hidden virtue; age after age it flourishes.

translations.literal: Forever mindful of accumulated merit; fine offering of excellent fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Forever mindful of accumulated merit, we offer fine fragrance.

sentences.zh: 太祖室，《皇武》為民請命，皇祖赫臨。

translations.literal: Shrine of Taizu, to the tune Huangwu: for the people he pleaded for the mandate; the august ancestor blaze-arrives.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's shrine, to the tune Huangwu: pleading the mandate for the people, the august ancestor blaze-arrives.

translations.literal: Heaven and Earth together bestow; a hundred million, one heart.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth bestow together; millions share one heart.

translations.literal: Founding the state by virtue; great blessing should be deep.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the state through virtue; great blessing should run deep.

translations.literal: Pouring that, only its savor; the true wanderer dwells and rejoices.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring its savor alone, the true spirit dwells and rejoices.

sentences.zh: 太宗室，《大定》皇矣太宗，嗣服平成！

translations.literal: Shrine of Taizong, to the tune Dading: august is Taizong; he succeeded the service and brought peace to completion!
translations.idiomatic: Taizong's shrine, to the tune Dading: august is Taizong—he succeeded the throne and brought peace to completion!

translations.literal: Ever more he roused the spirit hosts; again he campaigned against those not at court.
translations.idiomatic: Ever more he roused the spirit hosts, campaigning again against the rebellious.

translations.literal: Civil and martial, he upheld virtue; benevolence and filial piety could be bright.
translations.idiomatic: In civil and martial affairs he upheld virtue; benevolence and filial piety shone bright.

translations.literal: By the sage he transmitted the sage; responding in homage to the Purple Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Sage transmitted sage; we answer in homage to the Purple Clarity.

translations.literal: Shrine of Zhenzong, to the tune Xiwen
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong's shrine, to the tune Xiwen

translations.literal: Reflect on the cultured Zhenzong; embodying the Way, lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of cultured Zhenzong—embodying the Way in loftiness.

translations.literal: Tranquil majesty, blaze-spirit; following regulations, raising achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Tranquil majesty, blazing spirit—following rites, raising his achievements.

translations.literal: True talisman came like a tripod; announcing completion, ascending to feng.
translations.idiomatic: True talisman came like a tripod; he announced completion and ascended to feng.

translations.literal: Abundant virtue for a hundred generations; manifest without end.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant virtue for a hundred generations—manifest without end.

translations.literal: Shrine of Renzong, to the tune Meicheng
translations.idiomatic: Renzong's shrine, to the tune Meicheng

translations.idiomatic: Opening section mark
