translations.idiomatic: (Composed by Emperor Huizong) closing section mark

translations.literal: Benevolent virtue like Heaven; covering everywhere without partiality.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent virtue like Heaven covers all without partiality.

translations.literal: Achievement aided the nine realms; grace embraced the eight boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: His achievements aided the nine realms; grace embraced the eight boundaries.

translations.literal: The people received peace; court and countryside were tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: The people received peace; court and countryside were tranquil.

translations.literal: Striking the earth in song; forty-two years.
translations.idiomatic: They struck the earth in song—for forty-two years.

sentences.zh: 英宗室，《治隆》穆穆英宗，持盈守成。

translations.literal: Shrine of Yingzong, to the tune Zhilong: solemn and still is Yingzong; holding fullness, guarding accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzong's shrine, to the tune Zhilong: solemn is Yingzong—holding fullness, guarding accomplishment.

translations.literal: Worldly virtue as the quest; thus continuing, thus receiving.
translations.idiomatic: Worldly virtue was his quest; he continued and received the legacy.

translations.literal: Ordering the family, harmonizing the clan; laying down arms, restoring culture.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the family and harmonized the clan; laid down arms and restored culture.

translations.literal: In presenting clear libation, pouring it with joy.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting clear libation, we pour with joy.

sentences.zh: 神宗室，《大明》烝哉維後，繼明體神！

translations.literal: Shrine of Shenzong, to the tune Daming: abundant is the sovereign; continuing brightness, embodying spirit!
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong's shrine, to the tune Daming: abundant is the sovereign—continuing brightness, embodying spirit!

translations.literal: Examining antiquity, walking the Way; pattern and substance all renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Examining antiquity he walked the Way; pattern and substance were renewed.

translations.literal: Adorning the great enterprise; letting abundance hang down for those who come after.
translations.idiomatic: He adorned the great enterprise and enriched posterity.

translations.literal: Spirit banners surge abundantly; they come to feast, they come to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit banners surge; they come to feast, they come to rest.

translations.literal: Shrine of Zhezong, to the tune Chongguang
translations.idiomatic: Zhezong's shrine, to the tune Chongguang

translations.literal: Bright wisdom blaze-bright; shining down without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Bright wisdom blazes, shining down without bound.

translations.literal: Continuing and expounding the former will; truly proclaiming renewed radiance.
translations.idiomatic: He continued the former will and truly proclaimed renewed radiance.

translations.literal: Bequeathing counsel like a swallow's wings; all following the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He bequeathed counsel; all followed the old statutes.

translations.literal: Fragrant filial sacrifice; blessing descends, abundant and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant filial sacrifice—blessing descends in abundance.

translations.literal: Shrine of Huizong, to the tune Chengyuan
translations.idiomatic: Huizong's shrine, to the tune Chengyuan

translations.literal: Opening corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: Opening section mark

translations.literal: (Imperial composition) closing corner bracket
translations.idiomatic: (Imperial composition) closing section mark

translations.literal: O august is the blazing father; the Way transformed, sage and divine.
translations.idiomatic: O august blazing father—the Way transformed him, sage and divine.

translations.literal: Yao in keen hearing, Shun in filial piety; culture tranquil, martial joyful.
translations.idiomatic: Yao in keen hearing, Shun in filial piety—culture tranquil, martial joyful.

translations.literal: He commanded the son to emerge with thunder; leaving the fine steed, he ascended as guest on high.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded his son to emerge with thunder; leaving his fine steed, he ascended on high.

translations.literal: Boundless grief—since antiquity, none comparable.
translations.idiomatic: Boundless grief—since antiquity, none comparable.

sentences.zh: 降殿，《乾安》明德惟馨，進止回復。

translations.literal: Descending the hall, to the tune Qian'an: bright virtue alone is fragrant; advancing and stopping, returning and restoring.
translations.idiomatic: Descending the hall, to the tune Qian'an: bright virtue alone is fragrant; advancing and stopping in measured return.

translations.literal: Unveiled and layered robes, peaceful and reverent; stern as if in a valley.
translations.idiomatic: Unveiled and layered robes, peaceful and reverent—stern as in a valley.

translations.literal: Sincere intent blaze-bright and merged; the assembly of officers, sleeves linked.
translations.idiomatic: Sincere intent shines merged; officers stand with linked sleeves.

translations.literal: Completing this solemn bearing; born from unified solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: This solemn bearing is born of unified solemnity.

sentences.zh: 入小次，《乾安》於皇我後，祗戒專精。

translations.literal: Entering the lesser recess, to the tune Qian'an: O august is our sovereign; reverent caution, sole refinement.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the lesser recess, to the tune Qian'an: O august is our sovereign—reverent, cautious, wholly refined.

translations.literal: Personally composing sound and poetry; literary thought keen and bright.
translations.idiomatic: He personally composed hymns—literary thought keen and bright.

translations.literal: Dignified and at ease, he arrives and stops; jade-standing, upright and sincere.
translations.idiomatic: Dignified he arrives and stops—upright as jade, wholly sincere.

translations.literal: The spirits listen as if present; blessing and emolument come to rest.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits listen as if present; blessing and emolument come to rest.

translations.literal: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances, to the tune Zheng'an
translations.idiomatic: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances, to the tune Zheng'an

translations.literal: Eight sounds harmonize in pitch; dance markers fill the court.
translations.idiomatic: Eight sounds harmonize; dance markers fill the court.

translations.literal: Advancing in ranks, withdrawing in ranks; solemn, reverent, harmonious, peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing and withdrawing in ranks—solemn, reverent, harmonious, peaceful.

translations.literal: Grandly presenting to the ancestors; spirits oversee, blaze-bright ascent.
translations.idiomatic: Grandly we present to the ancestors; spirits oversee our bright ascent.

translations.literal: Emblemizing achievement, exalting virtue; forthwith beholding its completion.
translations.idiomatic: We emblemize achievement and exalt virtue, beholding its completion.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《正安》威神在天，享於克誠。

translations.literal: Second offering, to the tune Zheng'an: majestic spirit is in Heaven; enjoyment through able sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering, to the tune Zheng'an: majestic spirit is in Heaven—enjoyment through utmost sincerity.

translations.literal: Extended with the second libation; in manner manifesting fragrant virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Extended with the second libation, manifesting fragrant virtue.

translations.literal: Baskets and stands are greatly fine; music and dance all displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and stands are fine; music and dance all displayed.

translations.literal: May we approach being heard; blessing and emolument come to completion.
translations.idiomatic: May we be heard; blessing and emolument come to completion.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《正安》疏冪三舉，誠意一純。

translations.literal: Final offering, to the tune Zheng'an: thin veils raised three times; sincere intent, one pure.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering, to the tune Zheng'an: thin veils raised three times—sincere intent wholly pure.

translations.literal: Who accompanies my sacrifice? The ducal clans, stately and stately.
translations.idiomatic: Who accompanies my sacrifice? The ducal clans, stately and numerous.

translations.literal: The spirits all are drunk and stop; feasting in the deep and dark.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are fully drunk and at rest, feasting in the deep and dark.

translations.literal: For ten thousand such years, pacifying our thought of completion.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years, pacifying our thought of completion.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出小次，《乾安》夙戒告備，禮節俯成。

translations.literal: The emperor exits the lesser recess, to the tune Qian'an: early vigil announced complete; ritual sections bow to completion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor exits the lesser recess, to the tune Qian'an: early vigil announced complete; ritual sections bow to completion.

translations.literal: Properly assisting only Qian; misty vapor, night clear.

translations.idiomatic: Pouring aromatic vessel—simple, abundant, enriching posterity.

sentences.zh: 紹熙別廟二首安穆皇后室酌獻，《歆安》祥發伣天，符彰夢日。

translations.literal: Two hymns for separate temple in Shaoxi; libation at shrine of Empress Anmu, to the tune Xin'an: auspice sent matching Heaven; talisman manifest in dream sun.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi separate temple—two hymns; Anmu's shrine, Xin'an: auspice matches Heaven—dream sun talisman.

translations.literal: There is cherishing compassionate bearing; filial offering at temple chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Cherishing compassionate bearing—filial offering.

translations.literal: Great honored vessel is poured; fine ale fine chestnuts.
translations.idiomatic: Great vessel poured—fine ale and chestnuts.

translations.literal: Spirits thereby approach in thought; fortune thereby primal blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits approach—primal blessing.

sentences.zh: 安恭皇后室酌獻，《歆安》美詠河洲，德嬪媯汭。

translations.literal: Libation at shrine of Empress Angong, to the tune Xin'an: fine praise of Hezhou isle; virtue consort to Gui and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Angong's shrine, Xin'an: Hezhou praised—virtue consort to Gui and Wei.

translations.literal: Fine voice as if present; beginning cultivation of sacrificial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fine voice present—beginning sacrifice.

translations.literal: Bundled with wrapped thatch; poured with sweet ale.
translations.idiomatic: Wrapped thatch—sweet ale poured.

translations.literal: Spirits come to regard and delight; blessing descends, thereby prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits regard and delight—blessing prepared.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十九年顯仁皇后祔廟一首

translations.literal: One hymn for enshrining Empress Xianren in Shaoxing year 29
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for enshrining Empress Xianren, Shaoxing year 29

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《歆安》恭惟聖母，躋祔孔時。

translations.literal: Libation offering, to the tune Xin'an: reverent is the sage mother; ascending enshrinement at timely moment.
translations.idiomatic: Libation, Xin'an: reverent sage mother—timely enshrinement.

translations.literal: Displaying shame at spirit tablets; seeking blessing from kun ritual form.
translations.idiomatic: Displaying offerings at tablets—seeking kun blessing.

translations.literal: Bells and drums only ordered; victims and jade reverently presented.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums ordered—victims and jade presented.

translations.literal: O august coming to approach; forever aiding great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: O august approach—forever aiding foundation.

sentences.zh: 開禧三年成肅皇后祔廟一首

translations.literal: One hymn for enshrining Empress Chengsu in Kaixi year 3
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for enshrining Empress Chengsu, Kaixi year 3

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《歆安》天合重華，內治昭融。

translations.literal: Libation offering, to the tune Xin'an: Heaven united, double splendor; inner governance manifest and merged.
translations.idiomatic: Libation, Xin'an: Heaven united, double splendor—inner governance merged.

translations.literal: Receiving, receiving, continuing, continuing; protection and aid, grace lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving and continuing—protection and grace lofty.

translations.literal: Returning from Fu Mausoleum; ascending enshrinement in Great Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from Fu Mausoleum—enshrined in Great Palace.

translations.literal: Feasting us who come after; blessing and emolument come exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Feasting posterity—blessing exalted.
